newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 20.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- President Jacques Chirac to present on television tonight a planned reform of the French justice system which may include the possibility of making the public prosecutor's office independent of the justice minister.
-- Chairman of Credit Foncier de France held hostage at Paris headquarters by workers who protest a planned transfer of loan activity and part of staff to Credit Commercial de France.
-- EDF-GDF utility signs agreement with unions on cutting work week to 32 hours paid at least 35. Agreement says measure is expected to allow for hiring of up to 15,000 young workers through 1999.

-- CSA broadcast authority chairman Herve Bourges applauds dynamism showed by French subscriber-TV operators, but fears market may show weaknesses similar to those of the French air-carrier market, opening way for foreign firms.
